name: CWWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Havoc across the only surviving CWWF document to name a champion, defended once on record: against the debuting Godzilla, winner of the fed's own 16-cage 'Haunted Arena' gauntlet, at CWWF's first pay-per-view.

name: CWWF Television Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once on the surviving record, at CWWF's first pay-per-view: Sy Kopath won it from Earl of Doom in a hangman's match.

name: CWWF Television Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once on the surviving record: the Balls Brothers submitted the defending champions, More Ice, at CWWF's first pay-per-view — a title win that broke up the losing team on the spot.

name: CWWF World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Crusher across the only surviving CWWF document to name a champion, retained on record against MC Masters at the fed's first pay-per-view.

name: CWWF Hemisphere Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Changed hands once on the surviving record: Cawthorne pinned defending champion JC Ice at CWWF's first pay-per-view. A companion Hemisphere Tag Team Title is named on the same broadcast but was not defended that night, one half of its scheduled challengers sidelined by injury.
